final: WITH team_avgs AS (SELECT team_id, AVG(w) AS avg_wins, AVG((g - l) * 1.0 / NULLIF(l, 0)) AS avg_games_minus_losses_per_loss FROM manager_half GROUP BY team_id), mean_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_team_avg_wins FROM team_avgs) SELECT team_avgs.team_id, team_avgs.avg_wins, team_avgs.avg_games_minus_losses_per_loss, team_avgs.avg_wins - mean_avg.mean_team_avg_wins AS gap_above_mean FROM team_avgs CROSS JOIN mean_avg WHERE team_avgs.avg_wins > mean_avg.mean_team_avg_wins ORDER BY gap_above_mean DESC LIMIT 10
